newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM aluminium ends mixed after lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM aluminium ends mixed after lacklustre trade.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures ended mixed on Tuesday, as technical selling from individual investors erased earlier gains, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen lower to 0.5 yen higher, with benchmark April 1998 ending down 0.2 yen at 190.0 yen per kg.
Light buying by local investors emerged during the morning session, traders said. But the buying orders faded out and technical selling capped the topside, they said.
In London overnight, the benchmark three month aluminium added $12 to $1,590 per tonne, while flag-ship copper slumped $56 to $2,511 and zinc shot up to fresh 6-3/4 year highs.
